posts.name: Girish
posts.cooked:
Hello @sayan ,

I was going through the pyqs, I have a doubt in this question

Screenshot 2026-03-13 at 11.29.45 AM755×697 83.1 KB

For this question, you have mentioned if there are going to be d sub-directories, then the number of hardlinks to the directory is d+2 (including . and ..) But as per my understanding, it should be d+1, as .. is the hardlink of the parent directory of the current directory. Am I missing something here?

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
source of link Count
. inside testdir 1
.. from each subdirectory (d subdirs) d
entry testdir in the parent directory 1
Total d + 2

So, it is not from .. (parent directory) but the link from the parent directory to navigate to testdir.
